releases.name: v0.12.1
releases.html:
Added

  • The Architect app updates itself (#523): Updates (features/updates, UPDATES_* actions, Settings → Updates, a quiet status item) checks at start and daily, installs on Install (destructive: an outside caller waits for a person's yes) after verifying the org-signed SHA256SUMS, into the Nix launcher's ARCHITECT_UPDATE_DIR or over a writable APPIMAGE that is the image it runs from, else reports the download page; unsigned releases are reported, never installed. The release build stamps its version (ARCHITECT_RELEASE_VERSION via cargo xtask dist --version, which accepts only X.Y.Z or X.Y.Z-nightly.YYYYMMDD); an unstamped build is a development build that never offers updates. architect::release gains Updater::find, fetch_verified, persist_executable, write_atomic, staging_in, sweep_staging, ORG_KEY, Updater::limits and Candidate::notes_url; downloads are capped (1 GiB asset, 1 MiB sums and signature, ReleaseError::TooLarge), give up after 60 s without a byte instead of 30 min overall, and stage 0600 until verified (a new field: a struct literal of Candidate needs it).

  • Fixed the files engine's unbounded blob store (#525) without letting it lose a byte. Never losing bytes comes first, a bounded store second: where the two conflict, the engine defers or refuses and says so; it never deletes.

    • The cause. A node that holds its tree in place (hold_all) no longer copies the tree into <data dir>/files/blobs when it scans it (EngineConfig::keep_inline is 0 there). Its fetches land, and the versions it replaces are linked aside, on the tree's own filesystem: TreeStore::with_areas, layout::areas, <files_dir>/.architect/{incoming,versions}.
    • The budget. Added architect::blob::StoreBudget (LocalFs::with_budget, reserve, check_room, reconcile, remove, adopt, clean_orphans, fs_space, SpaceProbe): a size limit and a keep-free floor, checked before any byte is written and shared by concurrent writers. An unreadable filesystem refuses what needs the floor.
      • A write with no room is BlobError::NoRoom (NoRoom::too_large when it exceeds the whole limit), Progress::NoRoom, EngineError::NoRoom / TooLarge, and AgentError::NoRoom (HTTP 507).
      • The engine defers such writes (RootStatus::deferred, RootStatus::too_large, Engine::deferred, Engine::too_large) and retries each pass.
    • Placing bytes safely. Added architect::blob::{stage, commit, copy_verified_with, hash_file, STAGING, staging_path}. Every copy stages under one temp suffix, syncs, verifies length and sha-256, renames and syncs the directory before removing a source.
      • Engine::write_file stages the new version first, keeps the old one, re-checks the target and swaps with no clobber.
      • A target that changed meanwhile is EngineError::Changed; it is left for the scan.
      • layout::ignored covers every temp name; leftovers are removed at start.
    • Keeping versions. A replaced version is kept unless the versions area or the store already holds its bytes; another working file with the same bytes never counts.
      • A version that cannot be kept is EngineError::NoHistory (RootStatus::no_history, history_error).
      • Temp files are journalled (sync::pending::Pending); only the journal's are removed at start, and others are listed in RootStatus::strays.
      • At start, store files that share an inode with another name are re-hashed: changed ones are quarantined, unchanged ones get their own inode.
    • Deletes keep their bytes. Engine::apply writes first and deletes last, and every delete (a move's old name, a peer's delete, a WebDAV or S3 DELETE, a checkpoint restore) keeps the bytes before removing the file. History at its bound is EngineError::HistoryFull (RootStatus::history_full, files_store.history_full).
    • Links. architect::blob::stage links only a source with one name, else clones it (FICLONE) or copies and verifies it. The start-up check of shared store files runs before the first write and re-reads the working file's stat after a split. NoRoom names the area that refused.
    • A share the node cannot write. layout::claim_area returns Claimed::Unwritable: the node starts with history off (Engine::set_history_off). An empty .architect is claimed, and the mark is written atomically.
    • Eviction. Engine::evict_for_space drops only a store blob that a working file on the same device holds and that is no old version anywhere. It re-hashes the file just before, under the pass's lock, re-reading at most 2 GiB per pass (cross-holder eviction is #530). Engine::keep_store also cleans orphaned partial fetches (Fetcher::running).
    • History. Added Files::held / FILES_HELD (roots::VersionBytes, Engine::version_bytes): who holds each version's bytes, so a version no one holds says so. scan::Stat now carries the ctime and inode (Stat::same_file); an index from before is upgraded in place.
    • The node. It takes ARCHITECT_FILES_STORE_MAX, ARCHITECT_FILES_KEEP_FREE and ARCHITECT_FILES_HISTORY_MAX (bytes, 16Gi, 1.5Gi, 40%, units in any case; 0 and 100% are refused). Defaults: a quarter of the filesystem up to 100 GiB, 15% up to 64 GiB, and a tenth of the tree's filesystem up to 500 GiB for kept versions. An unreadable filesystem refuses writes that need the floor. A holding node refuses to start when <files_dir>/.architect is not its own folder (layout::claim_area). It logs each area's budget and where each number came from, and reports files_store in NODE_STATUS.
    • The chart. It sets the limit to 75% of the data volume, validates node.store.max, sets the floor to 15%, adds node.store.historyMax, an ephemeral-storage limit that counts an emptyDir /data, and an emptyDir sizeLimit.

    Migration: a match over BlobError, Progress, EngineError or AgentError needs arms for the new variants. A Files implementation needs held.

  • Added architect.playhead.attach(source) to the Sites player (features/sites/assets/player.js, #528): an outside clock (an audio engine on the page) drives the playhead in place of the page's media (time, playing, rate, duration; seek, play, pause asked of it; src the media it stands in for); the chart and lyrics follow it, the page's player yields (media paused, bar hidden); the handle's from carries the page's position, changed() repaints, detach() gives the clock back where the engine was; snapshots say source.

  • Added ARCHITECT_ORG_HOST (ORG_HOST_ENV, org_host_from_env): the node an account's orgs are hosted on until one is given for an org; devenv up points the app at its local node with it (#541)

  • Added NodeStatus relays and iroh_addrs (where the node is reachable over iroh); with ARCHITECT_IROH=local the node now binds loopback only, without iroh's default sockets on every interface (#541)

Fixed and improved

  • Fixed the divider between the navigator's folders and notes: a drag follows the pointer anywhere over the navigator, not only while it is on the 5px handle.
  • Fixed EngineHost with a dav mount: a request for a path no route has now goes through the finish layers (it went to a bare 404, so a loopback node with ARCHITECT_FILES_DIR answered no share link, #541)

releases.name: v0.12.0
releases.html:
Added

  • Added share audiences, the files page and Download all (#510): a Share carries named ShareAudiences, each a Bases filter over its scope on a link of its own (ShareLinks::add_audience / remove_audience; SHARE_AUDIENCE_ADD, SHARE_AUDIENCE_REMOVE, SHARE_AUDIENCES), built as its own site and checked against the vault on every request. Every link has <link>_files/ (views ?by=order|note|property:<key>) and <link>_archive.zip, a zip the node streams (SHARE_ARCHIVE saves it). New: architect_sites::Options::filter, architect_sites::listing (parse_filter, select, groups, Grouping), architect_sites::archive::ZipWriter, Scope::ordered, architect::http::HttpClient::download. Source changes for consumers: Share has a new field audiences (add audiences: Vec::new() to a literal), ShareLinks two new methods, SiteError a Filter variant, Options a filter field.
  • Added architect-editor (features/editor), the one door to FastTrackStudios/editor: its document model and Dioxus component re-exported (features state, ui with web or native, syntax), the language registry (Languages, Language, Grammar, Server, languages::builtin) and the syntax.* theme tokens (theme::TOKENS, theme::css). Extensions add languages with [[languages]] (LanguageDecl, Contributions::languages, Host::with_languages, Host::languages, EXT_LANGUAGES), in the registry while the extension is on. architect-extensions, vault-live and the app now reach the editor through architect-editor.
  • Added a player to share links and Sites (#511): audio and video embeds drawn as native players (architect_sites::media), served by the node with HTTP ranges (206, Content-Range, 416) behind the link's audience checks; each share page carries its link's queue in list order and plays it across pages; synced lyrics from an lrc fence or an embedded .lrc (architect_sites::lyrics::parse_lrc, LyricsBlocks) follow the playhead; every block follows architect.playhead or the data-follow-playhead/data-at attributes
  • Added cursors that come with the pane: with architect-workspace's presence feature and a PaneRoom (use_pane_room), every pane publishes and draws pointers with no view code; use_pane_subject, use_pane_space (ViewSpace, Axis) for views that scroll or zoom; the actions CURSORS_ROSTER, CURSORS_SPACE_SET, CURSORS_SPACE_CLEAR, CURSORS_HERE for extensions; PresenceMarksLayer; tabs show who is in a pane
  • architect-editor: the editor pin moves to editor main (editor#32). CodeEditor and TextEditor, Diagnostic and Severity, and the editor host-language API are re-exported. syntax::drive makes architect's language registry the editor's, so a language's fences and code editors are highlighted while its extension is on, and editors on screen draw again (ui::use_languages_revision, use_language). Grammars are linked into the binary: grammar = "linked:" names one the app or a linked extension hands over with syntax::link_grammar. A grammar file is refused at load, because the editor's tree-sitter cannot load one. CodeEditor is in the story gallery with a golden. Breaking: syntax::Unsupported::OwnQuery is gone (a language's own query now works), and NotLinked carries the grammar.
  • Language servers through the host (#512 (e)): architect_editor::lsp::LanguageServers runs a language's [languages.server] for each language and workspace root. Servers restart with backoff and stop when their last document closes or their extension is disabled. ui::use_code_document wires a CodeEditor to a server (diagnostics, didChange, a format's or rename's edits applied as one step). The extension host gains Host::with_language_servers, open_code (an extension's server runs only with capabilities.languages = ["servers"], granted) and install_editor_actions (EDITOR_SERVERS, EDITOR_DIAGNOSTICS, EDITOR_HOVER, EDITOR_COMPLETE, EDITOR_DEFINITION, EDITOR_FORMAT, EDITOR_RENAME). The Architect app runs them. lsp::stub is a stub server for tests (feature lsp-stub). Native only.
  • Added extension blocks on the node's share links and Sites (#488): architect_sites::InstalledBlocks draws the fences of the extensions installed in ARCHITECT_EXTENSIONS (<data dir>/extensions), embed pages and, with feature wasi (architect-desktop node-wasi), a WASI component's embed view (ComponentBlocks; the guest reads its input with architect_extension_wasi::embed()), ahead of a distribution's or an embedder's Blocks; Blocks is a BlockRenderer (claims, drawn_by). Security: what any renderer draws is sanitised by allow-lists (architect_sites::sanitize; an element tree goes through it too): SVG drawing elements inside an <svg> and basic HTML outside (text, lists, tables, links, images, <audio>/<video>, <details>, <button type="button">), their geometry and presentation attributes, class, title, lang, dir, role, aria-*, data-* and id (not the page's own: site-*, share-*, comments, data-site-*, data-act), and URLs only relative, #…, https:, mailto: (links) and raster data: images, every decision made on decoded values; no form fields, SMIL animation, <foreignObject>, on…, srcset or ping; CSS checked bluntly: a sheet, style value or presentation attribute holding a quote, comment, escape, var(), custom property or at-rule is refused before anything else, then anything that loads (url(, image-set(, paint(, …; a presentation attribute only url(#id)) and any position but static/relative; a block's images only relative or raster data:; ids shadowing the page script's globals (architect, …) reserved. The site wraps every block in a box of its own class and style (BLOCK_BOX_STYLE: contain, overflow: auto, position: relative, isolation), and a block's SVG <style> sheet is kept only as flat rules put under that class (Block::scope, architect_sites::sanitize_block, Drawn::into_block_html); plain sanitize keeps no sheet. Every share and Site page the node serves carries a Content-Security-Policy (script-src 'self' plus the site's theme script by hash, form-action 'self', object-src 'none', base-uri 'none'); a page's live reload is now read from <meta name="site-live"> by the site's script, not an inline script; the player reads its queue only from script#site-queue[type="application/json"]. API: elements_to_html and Drawn::into_html return Result (a tree past 100,000 elements or 16 MiB is refused). A component's edits can no longer put one node in two places or build a tree deeper than 256 levels, and its drawing is bounded as it is written (50,000 nodes, 16 MiB, the deadline checked). The share player follows SVG [data-at] elements, scrolls the nearest scrolling box by bounding rect and fills the current SVG bar from the theme. Bounds: sanitize is linear in its input on any input (at most 256 elements open), an element tree is written to 256 levels, and a component's drawing holds at most 50,000 nodes and 16 MiB.

releases.html:
Added

  • Guide films now draw exactly like the app: the runner mounts each window in the desk window's own document (architect_workspace::native::offscreen_document, with a head for document::Style), so every app stylesheet and dangerous_inner_html widget is in the film. Icon-only workspace tabs centre their icon.
  • The extension store's index is extensions/index.toml in architect's own repository (STORE_REGISTRY, STORE_DIR): a git registry in a folder of a repository (GitRegistry::in_dir, Registry::in_dir, EXT_REGISTRY_ADD {dir}), sparse-checked-out (#493).
  • Third parties' extensions in the Architect app: the store's registry and registries a person adds in Settings → Extensions (git or folder, kept in settings), each trusting its publishers' own keys, so a publisher signs its .archext with its own key; EXT_REGISTRIES, EXT_REGISTRY_ADD/REMOVE/REFRESH; development installs: EXT_DEV/EXT_DEV_END/EXT_DEV_INSTALLS and architect-desktop extensions dev <folder>, behind a setting or a debug build (#493).
  • Added architect-distribution: a distribution of Architect as code (Distribution: name, app name, folder, bundle id, icon, and the extensions and Bundles compiled in; architect() is the Architect app with its first-party extensions). architect_desktop::run takes a Distribution in place of architect_app::Mode (removed, with architect_app::mode::migrate_lab_folder: use Distribution::adopts / adopt_folder); apps/ui's use_lab_extensions links the distribution's list; <bin> distribution prints what it is. The registries a build installs from are the distribution's too (Distribution::registry, without_registries, without_installs; every distribution has the store's, architect_distribution::store, which moved here from apps/ui with STORE_REGISTRY / STORE_DIR; app_registries takes the distribution). The node's share links and Sites draw the fences its compiled-in extensions' embed pages claim, and the distribution's own renderers (node::start_with, Distribution::blocks, #488). Fixed architect-extensions' guest without the workspace-hack: it now turns on dioxus-html's serialize itself.
  • Added cargo xtask dist <desktop|node|node-image|web|web-image|all> [--manifest-path <crate>]: builds a distribution of Architect (a crate whose main is architect_desktop::run(..), the Architect app by default) through the release's own scripts and images, which now take the distribution's identity (scripts/desktop/linux.sh and macos.sh APP_*, scripts/web-bundle.sh ARCHITECT_DISTRIBUTION, flake.nix ARCHITECT_IMAGE_NAME / ARCHITECT_IMAGE_BIN); the release workflow builds the Architect app through it. Added /app/distribution.json to the web app (architect_web::Distribution): it takes the distribution's name and lists the extensions compiled in. Guide: Your own Architect.

No binaries or images for this tag. The release workflow failed to build them (devenv was missing on the release runners). Use v0.11.1, which has the same code plus the workflow fix.

Breaking / Migration

  • Added the agent tools for a running app (#268): the Action List refuses an unknown argument name with the valid ones (every door), carries a Problems registry and a StatusBoard (ActionList::problems, ActionList::status) read by APP_STATUS (architect::action::app_status::register); architect_control::guide::Guide writes <app dir>/AGENTS.md and actions.schema.json from the live list; actions shot [file] [--pane id] runs APP_SHOT (architect_workspace::shot::use_app_shot, feature native: the window's Blitz document painted on the CPU); EXT_CHECK {folder} (architect_extensions::check::Checker, Host::checker) and EXT_CLONE {id, as?} (Extensions::with_dev_root, clone_to_dev), Extensions::problems / report_problems; WORKSPACES_CLONE {name, as?} and WORKSPACES_RESTORE_BUILTINS; the escape hatch Ctrl+Alt+Shift+Escape (Cmd on macOS, Commands::escape_hatch, is_escape_hatch), which Keymap::bind refuses; the theme reports its theme section and problems (architect_theme::actions::report); the lab writes its guide, serves APP_STATUS/APP_SHOT, offers EXT_* on its list, adds LAB_GO {tab} and architect-desktop extensions check <folder>.

    Migration: an action call that sent an argument name the action does not take (ignored until now) is refused with bad_args; send only the names its schema lists. WORKSPACES_SAVE over a built-in screenset from a caller with a principal (MCP, the CLI, a script run as someone) answers changed: false, reason: builtin: WORKSPACES_CLONE it first. control::Env has a new field shipped and PaneInfo a new field rect (struct literals add them; Env::new sets shipped empty). Package::embedded keeps the manifest's text among its files as extension.toml.

  • Added an app's own theme tokens to architect-theme: dotted token names (arrange.item.edge) in theme files, layers, Theme::from_tokens and THEME_TOKEN_SET; values that name other tokens ($name, mix(a, b, t), alpha(a, t), module expr), evaluated after every layer, where an unknown name or a cycle draws magenta and is a Problem; Resolved::number, Resolved::source (TokenSource, Origin), Resolved::misses, Resolved::problems, Resolved::css_tokens, Resolved::css_namespaced and css_name; Projected::revision; a lock-free ThemeStore::revision; ThemeStore::insert_theme / remove_theme with Source::Memory themes that survive a reload; THEME_INSPECT, and an optional layer on THEME_TOKEN_SET / THEME_TOKEN_RESET. architect-ui's ThemeStoreProvider writes only architect's undotted tokens as CSS variables, and its css_namespaces prop (with ThemeStyle::from_resolved_with, ThemeState::from_resolved_with) opts an app's namespaces in

    Migration: Resolved::with_overrides is removed; layers' overrides go through the store (ThemeStore::set / set_token). Composed has two new public fields (chosen_by, set_by), so code that builds one by literal adds them. Source has a new variant, Source::Memory, so an exhaustive match on it adds an arm. An override value that starts with $, mix( or alpha( is now evaluated as an expression rather than kept as text.

  • Added the host service, consent and the extensions manager (#178, #181, #239 X5). architect-permissions: Principal::Extension { id, on_behalf_of } (Principal::extension, acting_for, extension_id); RoleEngine gives it at most the rules of on_behalf_of. architect: an extension acting for the app itself is not asked to confirm; one acting for an agent asks as the agent would. architect-extensions: the host service (hostcall::HostRequest / HostAnswer, hostapi::ExtensionApi from Host::api, AppContext, SettingValues, MemoryValues, Host::with_app_context, with_setting_values, with_data_root, set_app_list, capabilities, capabilities_of; over a process's connection host_proto::ExtensionHost and guest::host; Luau's host global; linked::Handle::host), with perm.* on each call's span; Capabilities::reads and capabilities (asks, grows_from, within, may_run); consent (consent::Grants, Scope, Host::with_grants); logs (logs::Logs, Host::logs); manage (Extensions::preview, install_with, update, pin, versions, Preview, Installed); actions EXT_PREVIEW, EXT_INFO, EXT_UPDATE, EXT_PIN, EXT_GRANT, EXT_REVOKE, EXT_GRANTS, EXT_LOGS, EXT_HOST_CALL, and EXT_INSTALL's grant and pin (Extensions::confirm_on); browse::Browse; the extensions manager (feature manager: manager::Manager, ItemKind, Item, Details, Op, the kinds ExtensionKind, ScriptKind, WorkerKind, ThemeKind, LayoutKind, and ManagerExtension with MANAGER_KINDS, MANAGER_LIST, MANAGER_GET, MANAGER_RUN); the page (feature page: ManagerPage, ManagerView, use_manager_page, ConsentPrompt, MissingExtensions). architect-settings: use_section_page. architect-workspace: layout and keys.json problems in APP_STATUS (Home::app_problems).

    Migration: match Principal::Extension where you match every principal. A runner's Context has api and logs. A manifest naming an unknown capabilities.reads is refused. An app that keeps consent (Host::with_grants) runs an installed extension with only what a person granted: grant what existing installs ask (EXT_GRANT). HOME_PROBLEMS answers {source, file, field, message} with the file's full path.

  • Added extensions that change the GUI at run time, and the interface as files. architect: action::Invocation and InvocationSource, ActionCaller::with_invocation / invocation (where a run came from and on what). architect-extensions: interface contributions in the manifest and at run time (contrib::Contribution: [[openers]] that claim files, doc_kinds and urls, [[doc_kinds]], [[tabs]], [[status]], [[menus]], [[context]], [[bar]], [[hooks]], [[slots]]; Manifest::contributes), the registry Contributions (a diff per load, withdrawn on unload) with owned, sequenced, time-limited runtime state (StateWrite); ViewDecl home, placement, width, height, on_unload; Host::contributions, Host::emit, Host::watch, Host::open (Opening), Host::set_view_opener / open_view (ViewOpen), Host::with_contributions, Host::with_spawn; hooks (startup, workspace.changed, doc.opened, theme.changed, selection.changed, changed:<topic>) running an action or a Luau script; Luau ctx and ext (contribute, state, clear); in-process extensions (linked::Extension, Builder, Handle, feature linked; Extensions::with_linked, Host::link, Host::linked_view, Guest::extension); wire 4 (ProcessExtension::run_in, the updates stream, wire::Update, Guest::action_in, guest::contribute, set_state, clear_state); the window side interface::use_extension_ui, ExtensionUi, ExtensionView, ExtensionOverlays, link_press; actions EXT_CONTRIBUTIONS, EXT_OPEN, EXT_VIEW_OPEN, EXT_STATE_SET, EXT_STATE_CLEAR, EXT_EMIT, EXT_ENABLE, EXT_DISABLE (Extensions::install_contribution_actions). architect-shell: the chrome as slots (Chrome, Slot, Filler, use_chrome, Chrome::over), contributed tabs, status items and bar buttons, named_icon, intern. architect-theme: ThemeStore::resolve_with. architect-commands: MenuBar::contributed, Commands::run_invoked. architect-workspace: ContextEntries / ContextEntry for a pane's context menu; feature home (home::Home: layouts/<name>.json, keys.json, .state/, last-good with a .error, read-only built-ins, home::Problem; HOME_LAYOUTS, HOME_LAYOUT_USE, HOME_SLOT_SET, HOME_PROBLEMS; home::ui).

Instance has two new provided methods (hook, declared). The process wire is version 4: a host takes wire 2 to 4, but a host built before this change refuses a wire-4 process, so update the host before its process extensions; ProcessExtension has a new method run_in and a new stream updates, which an implementation outside guest::Guest adds. The ui feature now depends on architect-shell, architect-workspace/ui and architect-commands/ui, and implies linked.

  • Added live theming for extensions and the GUIs they draw. architect-theme: ThemeStore::contribute / withdraw / contribution and Contribution (an owner's themes, broken files and token defaults, diffed, last good kept), the LayerKind::Extension layer (under the theme's own overrides), Source::label (THEME_LIST says extension:<id>), TOKEN_NAME_RULE, Rgba::packed. architect-extensions: a manifest [tokens] table (Manifest::tokens, Manifest::token_namespace, ManifestError::BadToken), Host::with_themes and host::theme_contribution (an extension's [[themes]] and tokens into the app's store while it is loaded, a broken file a THEME_PROBLEMS entry), ProcessRunner::with_theme and the theme as data to a process (wire::ThemeData, ProcessExtension::theme, wire 3), Guest::theme, Guest::on_theme and guest::use_theme. architect-scripting: theme::ThemeModule (theme.color, number, value, scheme, id, revision, snapshot, subscribe; a frozen snapshot per revision) over ThemeSource (ThemeStore, ThemeCell), and Module::frame / Module::live_fields. architect-canvas: imgui::Style::from_theme and imgui::Col (each style colour from an imgui.* token or derived from the shell's), Ui::push_style_color / pop_style_color and ImGui.PushStyleColor / PopStyleColor / ImGui.Col_*, luau::Session::start_themed / set_theme; use_script_canvas follows the theme store above it, so a Luau ImGui window no longer keeps the colours it started with.

    Migration: LayerKind has a new variant, Extension (second, after Builtin), and LayerKind::ALL nine entries: an exhaustive match adds an arm. ThemeStore::registry now includes contributed themes. Manifest has a new public field, tokens, and ManifestError a new variant, BadToken, so code that builds a Manifest by literal or matches the error exhaustively adds them. architect-theme is now a regular dependency of architect-extensions (it was optional, behind remote). The process wire is version 3 (wire::WIRE): a host takes wire 2 and 3 (wire::WIRE_MIN), but a host built before this change refuses a wire-3 process, so update the host before its process extensions.   • Added runtime themes: architect-theme (a palette resolved into every semantic token, the cascade of layers, ThemeStore, strict hot-reloading theme files, THEME_* actions); ShellTheme's fields are now Arc (no longer Copy) with ShellTheme::from_resolved, AppShell follows the theme store when given no theme, architect-ui's presets are architect-theme's built-in files and ThemeStoreProvider follows a store, PaintPane hands views the resolved theme as ThemeTokens, Icon.color is an Arc, shell_tokens names the accent trio brand/brand-ink/brand-soft, and extension.toml may declare [[themes]]

  • Turso stores wait up to 5 s for the file's lock instead of failing with "database is locked" when the index, the persistence or a restarted process hold it.
  • Fixed a list row's feature image showing only its middle: it fits its thumbnail box (object-fit: contain) (#442).
  • Fixed a vault note opening as raw Markdown in a 480px box: it opens as Obsidian's live preview (headings, lists, tasks that toggle, callouts, code, tags, images from the vault, wikilinks that open their note) and grows with the pane. Added a Properties panel above it for its frontmatter, folded by default, each property typed (text, list, number, checkbox, date, datetime, tags, links) and added, renamed, reordered or removed in place (#442).
  • Fixed a main-area view (EXT_VIEW_OPEN with placement tab or split, and the workspace's view opener) opening in a dock's group in place of its pane when the dock had the focus: it opens beside the document on show (#442).
  • Fixed walk_vault listing dot-files and dot-folders (.empty-folders, .DS_Store): they are hidden anywhere in the vault, as vault-live's walker hides them. Fixed frontmatter_write::write_frontmatter writing an added empty key as key: null; it writes key:, as Obsidian does (#442).
  • Fixed Files in the navigator with no project folder on the device: it shows "Add a project folder" and "Connect to a node" (empty_state) instead of "no action FILES_ROOTS" (#443)
  • Changed the Calendar navigator provider's periods into its list's groups, for the navigator's Calendar row (#443)
  • Fixed decks in the app (#468): DECK_OPEN {context: {kind: project, id}} opens the project's page in the Project screenset, as a middle-click does, and a project's row in the navigator's Projects loads onto a deck on a middle-click or ⌘-click; the navigator follows the deck on show (a project's row in Projects, a song's setlist, the whole navigator on the vault's deck), each deck keeping its own selection; the Setlists demo dates songs by their own dates or their file's mtime.
  • A desk's title row is Obsidian's 40px header height in full screen and in the web app too, not 52px, matching the row with window buttons.
  • Changed project rows to the project glyph instead of folder-kanban (a folder and a project at once): the Projects row and its projects, sub-projects, Files' project roots and a project's deck tab, with the project's own icon and color (now read by Projects) over it.
  • Changed a project's note (<folder>/project.md) to be titled by its project, its title else its folder's name, in Recent Files and the lists (NoteFile::project_name), on its tab and on its scope tab (#476).
  • Changed a Vaults/ or Assets/ row, and a note from another org in a list, to show its org by a light wash of the org's colour (OrgBadge::tint) instead of the org's initial badge; the org is the row's data-org and its description. A theme sets how strong the wash is with the number navigator.org-wash (0 to 1, 0.08 by default, 0 turns it off; NUMBERS).
